packages.name: coreutils
packages.description: uutils coreutils: ls, cat, sort, wc, sha256sum and 70 more as one multi-call binary
packages.notes: Applets don't replace Shiro's builtins of the same name; run them as `coreutils ls` or /usr/bin/ls. No chmod/chown/stat/id: WASI has no owners or modes.

packages.name: lua
packages.description: Lua 5.4 interpreter and bytecode compiler (PUC-Rio)
packages.notes: The interactive REPL needs blocking stdin; scripts, -e and piped input work. No os.execute/io.popen (no child processes).

packages.name: python3
packages.description: CPython 3.13 interpreter built for WASI (stdlib, zlib, sqlite3); pip and venv are provided by Shiro
packages.notes: pip installs pure-Python wheels from PyPI (no native extensions, no sdists yet); python -m venv works. No subprocess, sockets or ssl (WASI preview1); the REPL needs blocking stdin.

packages.name: make
packages.description: GNU make: recipes run as kernel processes (sh -c through posix_spawn)
packages.notes: Built with Shiro's process shim (scripts/pkgbuild/compat/wasi-proc.c). No jobserver: -j runs one job at a time. No -O output sync, load average, guile or loadable modules.

packages.name: llvm
packages.description: Clang/LLVM 21 for WASI: clang, clang++, cc, c++, wasm-ld, llvm-ar and friends, with the wasi-libc sysroot (targets wasm32-wasip1)
packages.notes: The compiler is YoWASP's LLVM for WASI (npm @yowasp/clang, taken from its tarball); clang's driver steps run as separate kernel processes (compat/clang-driver.c). Output is wasm32-wasip1; run it like any WASM program.

packages.name: go
packages.description: The Go toolchain (go, gofmt, compile, link, asm, vet) running on wasip1; builds GOOS=wasip1 programs (and other targets) inside Shiro
packages.notes: Patched (scripts/pkgbuild/go/wasip1-processes.patch) so os/exec works on Shiro's kernel; the shipped std has it too. Comes with a build cache of common std packages, so small programs build in seconds; anything else in std compiles on first use. No network: GOPROXY=off, vendor modules or use replace directives.

packages.name: sqlite
packages.description: SQLite 3 command-line shell (FTS5, math functions)
packages.notes: Interactive mode needs blocking stdin; SQL as an argument or on stdin works. Single-threaded, no WAL, no extensions.

packages.name: jq
packages.description: Command-line JSON processor (with oniguruma regex)

packages.name: cowsay
packages.description: Configurable talking cow (Rust port)

packages.name: figlet
packages.description: FIGlet 2.2.5: large letters out of ordinary text, with 57 fonts

packages.name: uuid
packages.description: Generate UUIDs

packages.name: wabt
packages.description: WebAssembly Binary Toolkit: wat2wasm, wasm2wat, wasm-validate, wasm-strip, wasm-interp

packages.name: ruby
packages.description: Ruby 3.4 (ruby.wasm CLI build): ruby, irb, gem, rake, bundle, with the standard library and default gems
packages.notes: Built with prefix /usr/local: the package mounts lib/ruby there for its processes. irb needs blocking stdin. No sockets: gem install from rubygems.org doesn't work; installing local .gem files does.

packages.name: perl
packages.description: Perl 5.40 (static x86-64 build run in the Blink engine): fork, exec, system() and backticks work
packages.notes: An x86-64 Linux binary in Blink: needs a cross-origin isolated page. Interpreted, so starting is ~1 s and big modules (POSIX) take seconds to load. No XS module loading (all core XS is built in); no pods (perldoc).

packages.name: ninja
packages.description: Ninja build system (static x86-64 build run in the Blink engine)
packages.notes: An x86-64 Linux binary in Blink: needs a cross-origin isolated page. Build commands run with posix_spawn; Shiro programs (clang from the llvm package, the shell) run as kernel processes.

packages.name: cmake
packages.description: CMake and CTest (static x86-64 musl build run in the Blink engine)
packages.notes: An x86-64 Linux binary in Blink: needs a cross-origin isolated page. Generates Makefiles or Ninja files for the llvm package's clang (install make or ninja too); no OpenSSL (file(DOWNLOAD) of https fails), no ccmake/cmake-gui.

packages.name: fortune
packages.description: Print a random adage

packages.name: lolcat
packages.description: Rainbow-colour text

packages.name: brotli
packages.description: Brotli compressor and decompressor

packages.name: openssl-wasm
packages.description: OpenSSL 1.1 command-line tool: digests, base64, symmetric ciphers, keys
packages.notes: No networking (s_client needs sockets). The `openssl` package is now OpenSSL 3.5 as a static x86-64 build (needs a cross-origin isolated page).

packages.name: qr2text
packages.description: Render a QR code as text

packages.name: viu
packages.description: Show images in the terminal

packages.name: quickjs
packages.description: QuickJS JavaScript engine (2019 release)

packages.name: util-linux
packages.description: cal from util-linux: print a calendar
packages.notes: Only cal: this 2019 build's rev/hexdump/col crash or lose output in this runtime (Shiro has rev and hexdump builtins).

packages.name: bash
packages.description: GNU Bourne-Again Shell (WASIX build)
packages.notes: WASIX build (wasix_32v1, shared env.memory). fork, setjmp/longjmp and exec run as kernel processes (asyncify stack capture); interactive on the terminal's pty.

packages.name: dash
packages.description: Debian Almquist shell (WASIX build)
packages.notes: WASIX build (wasix_32v1, shared env.memory). fork, setjmp/longjmp and exec run as kernel processes (asyncify stack capture); interactive on the terminal's pty. This early build's exec passes no environment, so exported variables don't reach child programs (bash's does).

packages.name: grep-wasix
packages.description: GNU grep (WASIX build)
packages.notes: WASIX build (wasix_32v1, shared env.memory). Run it as /usr/bin/grep (the builtin keeps the name). grep -r fails with ENOSYS.

packages.name: sed-wasix
packages.description: GNU sed (WASIX build)
packages.notes: WASIX build (wasix_32v1, shared env.memory). Run it as /usr/bin/sed (the builtin keeps the name).

packages.name: less-wasix
packages.description: less pager (WASIX build)
packages.notes: WASIX build (wasix_32v1, shared env.memory). Run it as /usr/bin/less (the builtin keeps the name).

packages.name: ripgrep
packages.description: ripgrep recursive search (WASIX build)
packages.notes: WASIX build (wasix_32v1, shared env.memory). Run it as /usr/bin/rg (the builtin keeps the name).

packages.name: curl-wasix
packages.description: curl URL transfer tool (WASIX build, OpenSSL)
packages.notes: WASIX build (wasix_32v1, shared env.memory). HTTP and HTTPS (its own OpenSSL, CA certificates mounted at /openssl) through the kernel sockets and the TCP relay. The `curl` package is now curl 8.22 as a static x86-64 build (needs a cross-origin isolated page).

packages.name: quickjs-ng
packages.description: QuickJS-ng JavaScript engine (WASIX build)
packages.notes: WASIX build (wasix_32v1, shared env.memory).

packages.name: php
packages.description: PHP 8.3 interpreter (WASIX build)
packages.notes: WASIX build (wasix_32v1, shared env.memory). 86 MB download. setjmp/longjmp (zend_bailout) through asyncify stack capture.

packages.name: python
packages.description: CPython 3.13 with pip (WASIX build)
packages.notes: WASIX build (wasix_32v1, shared env.memory), a position-independent (dylink.0) module using WASIX dynamic calls; its standard library, CA certificates, tzdata and terminfo are volumes mounted at their /nix/store paths and /etc/ssl. Shiro's `python` builtin (Pyodide) stays the default `python`.

packages.name: clang
packages.description: clang 16, lld and llvm-ar/nm with a wasm32-wasi sysroot (WASIX build)
packages.notes: WASIX build (wasix_32v1, shared env.memory). 111 MB download. `clang` is clang-16-slim with the package's driver flags (wasm32-wasi, threads, shared imported memory); the sysroot and clang's headers are mounted at /sysroot and /lib, and the driver runs wasm-ld as a child process.

packages.name: less
packages.description: less pager (static x86-64 build; reads keys from /dev/tty)

packages.description: Vi IMproved (huge features, syntax highlighting, :help; static x86-64 build)

packages.description: Neovim: hyperextensible Vim-based text editor (PUC Lua 5.1, runtime with :help; static x86-64 build)

packages.description: GNU diff, cmp, diff3, sdiff

packages.description: GNU patch: apply diffs

packages.name: openssl
packages.description: OpenSSL 3.5 LTS command-line tool (static x86-64 build)
packages.notes: s_client and other network commands use kernel sockets: TCP leaves the page through the relay (SHIRO_TCP_RELAY).

packages.name: curl
packages.description: curl: transfer URLs (HTTP/HTTPS/FTP...; OpenSSL, zlib; static x86-64 build)
packages.notes: Connections go through the kernel's sockets: the TCP relay for the internet, the page for localhost.

packages.name: git
packages.description: Git distributed version control (real git: libcurl/OpenSSL for https remotes)
packages.notes: Replaces Shiro's built-in git (isomorphic-git) while installed; `builtin git` still reaches it. Remotes over https need the TCP relay.
